cli_help.output:
usage: study_compare.py [-h] --data-root DATA_ROOT --evidence EVIDENCE
                        [--registration-commit REGISTRATION_COMMIT]
                        {baseline,pack,analyse} ...

Run the fixed lexical method, prepare masked assessments and analyse frozen
human ratings.

positional arguments:
  {baseline,pack,analyse}

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --data-root DATA_ROOT
  --evidence EVIDENCE
  --registration-commit REGISTRATION_COMMIT

usage: study_compare.py baseline [-h] [--previous PREVIOUS]
                                 [--retry-reason RETRY_REASON]
                                 selection_id

positional arguments:
  selection_id

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --previous PREVIOUS
  --retry-reason RETRY_REASON

usage: study_compare.py pack [-h] --attempts ATTEMPTS [--profile PROFILE]
                             baseline_sha256

positional arguments:
  baseline_sha256

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --attempts ATTEMPTS
  --profile PROFILE

usage: study_compare.py analyse [-h] --ratings RATINGS comparison_sha256

positional arguments:
  comparison_sha256

options:
  -h, --help         show this help message and exit
  --ratings RATINGS
